name: tests-75pct-opcua-negotiated-secure-channel-message-3270
instr:
Add secure-channel request planning and message limits.

MessageLimitsOption accepts message-size, chunk-count and chunk-size limits individually and together through ApplyConfig/NewClient. Zero limits preserve StatusBadServerNotConnected from disconnected Client.Send.

UASC Header.WireSize matches encoded MSG, OPN and CLO headers. Invalid message/chunk types return *PlanError with PlanErrorInvalidFrame. SymmetricSecurityHeader and SequenceHeader sizes match encoding. MessageHeader.WireSize sums header, security-header and sequence contributions for symmetric and asymmetric framing. An asymmetric header whose encoded contribution exceeds the size range returns PlanErrorOverflow.

For a connected security-None client with MaxMessageSize 4096, PlanRequest on a small ReadRequest returns positive BodySize and one final ChunkPlan with positive BodySize and WireSize greater than body size. An oversized ReadRequest makes PlanRequest and Client.Send return PlanErrorMessageSize; Send does not invoke its callback. With MaxChunkCount 1 and MaxChunkSize 4096, an oversized multi-chunk request returns PlanErrorChunkCount.

OPN EncodeChunks rejects a body requiring multiple chunks with PlanErrorChunkSize. A client advertising MaxMessageSize 4096 receives an error and no callback when a ReadRequest would produce an oversized response.

Preserve existing behaviour.

These are required in what you deliver:

- github.com/gopcua/opcua: MessageLimitsOption(limits uasc.MessageLimits), usable with
